exemplars.title: Improved Lower Bounds for Privacy under Continual Release
exemplars.usage: Gadgets embed inner-product queries into graph streams; packing/reidentifiable-distribution arguments yield sample-complexity bounds; binary-tree mechanisms plus composition give near-matching upper bounds.
exemplars.quote: "Any (ε,δ)-DP incremental mechanism ... for maintaining the size of the maximum matching, degree histogram, or core number of a vertex must have additive error α = Ω(min{T^a, n^b})."

exemplars.title: Clustering with Set Outliers and Applications in Relational Clustering
exemplars.usage: LP feasibility plus greedy rounding with weight-charging arguments; Set-Cover reductions via line-point encodings; coresets shrink instances; randomized repetition over join samples.
exemplars.quote: "If the Unique games conjecture is true, there exists no (1, f−ε, γ)-approximation algorithm that runs in polynomial time for the problem, where f = o(log n)."

exemplars.title: Query Answering Under Volume-Based Diversity Functions
exemplars.usage: Measure-algebra submodularity proof; combinatorial reductions; marginal diversity evaluated as a tropical-semiring sum-product query; ranked enumeration with compatible rankings for preprocessing.
exemplars.quote: "Let Ω be any volume assignment over a universe U of possible solutions. Then δ_Ω is always monotone and submodular."

exemplars.title: Representation Obliviousness and Pseudodeterminism in Streaming Algorithms
exemplars.usage: Reduction chain from ROPD F0 estimator to ROPD Promise-Union protocol to PD Disj protocol, contradicting CC(Disj)=Ω(m); canonical-value and output-distribution arguments.
exemplars.quote: "Let ε, δ ≤ 1/3. Any ROPD streaming algorithm that (ε, δ)-approximates F0 requires Ω(n) space (where n is the size of the universe)." (Thm 3.1)

exemplars.title: A Unifying Algorithm for Hierarchical Queries
exemplars.usage: Variable-elimination rules (private variables, duplicate atoms) with invariant induction; homomorphism φ commuting with monoid operations transfers provenance to each application; bipartite-clique reduction for hardness.
exemplars.quote: "Then, the output of Algorithm [hierarchical] on Q and D_φ is the φ-mapping of the output of Algorithm [hierarchical] on Q and D₊."

exemplars.title: Tractability Frontiers of the Shapley Value for Aggregate Conjunctive Queries
exemplars.usage: #Set-Cover and permanent reductions via databases whose Shapley values encode coverage counts; Shapley linearity/symmetry/dummy axioms to decompose; injective transformations shifting value functions across aggregation.
exemplars.quote: "If Q is [hierarchical], then φ(f, A_α) is computable in polynomial time ... Otherwise, there is a localized [value function] such that computing φ(f, A_α) is #P-complete."

exemplars.title: On Sketching Trimmed Statistics
exemplars.usage: Geometric level sets with random threshold ζ; dyadic subsampling isolates Θ(log n/ε²) survivors; CountSketch/heavy-hitter identification; Chernoff plus union bound over levels.
exemplars.quote: "there exists a linear sketch that uses poly(log n/ε) bits of space and estimates Σ_{i=1}^k |a_i|^p up to a (1±ε) multiplicative factor with high constant probability."

exemplars.title: Finding Heavy-Hitters with Optimal State Changes
exemplars.usage: Morris/Morris+ counters with sub-gamma tails (Lemma 22, exp(−cR)); competing-pairs counting plus Markov for counter survival; dyadic subsampling (Lemmas 13/14); exponential max-stability (Prop 15) for Fk tracking; lower bound from crafted streams with one repeated item.
exemplars.quote: "Let k ∈ [1, ∞). Suppose that an algorithm solves the (ε, ℓk)-heavy-hitter problem with probability at least 3/4. Then this algorithm must use at least Ω(n^{1−1/k} ε^{-1} log(1/ε)) state changes." (Thm 6)

exemplars.title: Privacy Loss of Noise Perturbation via Concentration Analysis of A Product Measure
exemplars.usage: Radon–Nikodym product-measure lemma; exponent-optimized Markov bound; AMP sensitivity/Jacobian bounds; linear DP composition.
exemplars.quote: "if σ_M ≥ (Δ₂f/ε)·t, then the product noise achieves (ε,δ)-DP on the perturbed f(x) ... the expected magnitude of our product noise is reduced by a factor of Θ(log 1/δ) relative to the classic Gaussian noise."

exemplars.title: A Bouquet of Results on Maximum Range Sum: General Techniques and Hardness Reductions
exemplars.usage: Grid-shifted random sampling of points with Chernoff plus union bound for weighted-depth concentration; guard-point encodings reduce (min,+)-convolution to batched MaxRS; trapezoidal maps for exact colored enumeration.
exemplars.quote: "Assuming that (min,+)-convolution on sequences of length n requires Ω(n²) time, the batched MaxRS problem on n points and m query interval lengths requires Ω(mn) time."

exemplars.title: Acyclic Graph Pattern Counting under Local Differential Privacy
exemplars.usage: Parallel/basic DP composition, Laplace concentration, Chernoff on effective degrees, Chebyshev for sampling error; random marking reduces path counting to walk counting.
exemplars.quote: "The k-round mechanism satisfies E[M(G,ε)] = W_k, and with probability at least 1−β, |M(G,ε) − W_k| ≤ kγ√N(d(G)+γ)^{k−1} = Õ(√(N·d(G)^{k−1}))."

exemplars.title: DP-S4S: Select-Join-Aggregate Query Processing with User-Level DP
exemplars.usage: Rényi-divergence convexity and Bernstein/Chernoff bounds drive amplification and error proofs; SVT searches the truncation threshold.
exemplars.quote: "Algorithm 2 satisfies (ε,0)-DP; with probability 1−β its error is Õ(√(n/q) + 1/q + τ*(T) + τ*(T)/(qε*))."

exemplars.title: FPT Parameterisations of Fractional and Generalised Hypertree Width
exemplars.usage: MSO transductions lift Bojańczyk–Pilipczuk; elimination forests with a Reduced-Hypergraph Dealternation Lemma bound alternation depth; conflict-graph coloring and neutral-swap/pigeonhole arguments; induction over forests.
exemplars.quote: "it is fixed-parameter tractable to check ghw(H) ≤ k and fhw(H) ≤ k parameterised by k, rank(H), Δ(H)."

exemplars.title: The Space-Time Complexity of Sum-Product Queries

exemplars.quote: "For any ε > 0, no algorithm can solve this problem over the tropical semi-ring in space S=O(|E|^k4−ε) and time T=O(|E|^k2)."

exemplars.title: Efficient Exact Resistance Distance Computation on Small-Treewidth Graphs

exemplars.quote: "Such a sketch must use at least N/E(N) · [Ω(log 1/δ + log log(N/E(N))) − Θ(1)] bits of memory at some point in time while processing a stream."

exemplars.usage: Absorbing-random-walk interpretation of L_v^{-1}; pushback invariant by induction (Lemma 4.1); unbiased tree-sampling estimators via electrical networks/Kirchhoff (Lemma 6.1, Cor 6.2); Chernoff-Hoeffding plus union bounds.

exemplars.quote: "there is a set P of Θ(n) points ... such that any 2-PG for P must have Ω(n log Φ) edges, regardless of the query time allowed."

exemplars.title: Constrained Shortest Path Finding on Terrain Surfaces
exemplars.usage: Contradiction and induction for spanner lemmas; triangle-inequality charging; Kruskal MST plus pre-order traversal gives the factor 2.
exemplars.quote: "It holds that dg(u,v) ≤ dG(u,v) ≤ (1+ε)·dg(u,v), where dG(u,v) is the shortest distance between u and v on G."

exemplars.title: Fast-Convergent Proximity Graphs for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
exemplars.usage: Doubling-dimension ball covers over dyadic rings bound out-degree; per-hop distance shrinking by factor α bounds the routing path length.
exemplars.quote: "The α-CG G has space O(n · (ατ)^d log Δ) and can be constructed in O(n² · ((ατ)^d log Δ + log n)) time."

exemplars.title: Effective Clustering for Large Multi-Relational Graphs
exemplars.usage: Neumann series with Lidskii/Courant–Fischer eigenvalue arguments; Sinkhorn–Knopp scaling (Birkhoff–von Neumann) for a symmetric doubly stochastic affinity; CountSketch for scalable norm estimation.
exemplars.quote: "If S_ω is doubly stochastic and Z=Y^T, optimizing [the relaxed objective] is equivalent to optimizing Σ_k Σ_{v_i∈C_k} ‖z_i − c^(k)‖²₂, where c^(k) is the center of cluster C_k."

exemplars.title: HeteroFedSyn: Differentially Private Tabular Data Synthesis for Heterogeneous Federated Settings
exemplars.usage: zCDP additivity plus post-processing for budget allocation across marginals; expectation calculations strip projection and noise bias; random projection compresses 2-way marginals before release; greedy selection trades noise error against dependency error.
exemplars.quote: "z_{a,b} − ‖z_{a∗b}‖²₂ − [kασ₂² + ασ₁²(s_b‖M̂_a‖²₂ + s_a‖M̂_b‖²₂) − s_a s_b α²σ₁⁴] is an unbiased estimator of the square of InDif²_{a,b}."

exemplars.title: Accelerating High-Dimensional ANN Search via Skipping Redundant Distance Computations
exemplars.usage: JL distortion bounds turn distance thresholds into cheap projected-space comparisons; orthogonal-transform invariance enables multiplication-free iterative refinement.
exemplars.quote: "If δ(p,q) < τ, then Pr(‖A(p−q)‖²₂ < (1+ε)d/D·τ) > p1; if δ(p,q) > τ, then Pr(‖A(p−q)‖²₂ < (1+ε)d/D·τ) < p2."
